claims.claim: Tanks are chemically resistant / suitable for chemicals and other uses
claims.evidence: Report shows no chemical-resistance markings and cannot show chemical history or suitability.

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: No brand or model is legible; previous contents and food-grade status are not shown in the photos.

claims.claim: No crack, no leak, lids complete
claims.evidence: Report lists leaks, cracks, and lid condition as not shown; only one lid is visible on the foreground tank.

risks.proof: Video clip of each tank filled with water and inspected for seepage

risks.risk: Previous contents were chemicals or non-food substances
risks.proof: Seller proof of prior use (receipts, photos, or written declaration) or interior residue test
risks.if_unproven: as previously used for unknown or non-food contents (not food grade)

risks.risk: Valves or lids do not work properly
risks.proof: Video of the valve opening and closing and the lid sealing
Video of interior cleaning or a sanitation receipt

risks.risk: Exact capacity in liters is unknown
risks.proof: Photo of a capacity label or a measurement clip

risks.risk: Wooden pallets are broken or rotting

proof_requests: Video of each tank filled with water to check for leaks and cracks
Video of valve operation and lid sealing
Proof of previous contents and food-grade status
Close-up photos of the wooden pallets
response.reason: The witness identifies caged water tanks, so a worst-case remote price is possible; condition claims are unproven and priced down until verified.
